conditions.cold_note: cold phase includes one-time model load on first embedding call; server keep-alive may shorten later cold starts
negatives: how do I bake sourdough bread
explain the offside rule in soccer
what is the capital of Assyria
conditions.percentiles: mean/p50/max only; n=14 per arm supports no p95/p99

chunking.description: Candidate texts built as symbol plus sorted token set, exactly as Memory.answer constructs them.

preprocessing.description: Raw text as constructed; no normalization, truncation, or stopword removal.

limitations: 14 small synthetic tasks; not a general semantic-retrieval claim.
Semantic candidates are proposals only; graph edges unchanged.
n=14 supports means and p50 only; no p95/p99, no confidence intervals.
Server-side embedding time and RAM not instrumented; misses count client-side texts sent.
Negatives are fixed calibration probes, not a held-out suite.
